content.value: Sassly is an on-brand AI copilot for businesses. It helps creators use generative AI to break through writer’s block, draft in a voice that already sounds like them, and get from a blank page to a first version in minutes.

Because it learns your brand rather than averaging everyone else’s. You load your own guidelines and past work once, and every draft after that comes back in your tone, with your terminology, ready to edit rather than rewrite.

item_title.value: Can I upgrade to a different plan at a later time?

content.value: Can I upgrade to a different plan at a later time?
Any time, in either direction. Upgrades take effect immediately and you pay only the prorated difference; downgrades apply at your next renewal so nothing you rely on stops mid-cycle.

item_title.value: What’s the cost of additional users?

content.value: What’s the cost of additional users?

Seats are billed per user per month at your plan’s rate, and adding one mid-cycle is prorated to the day. Team plans include shared brand settings and a pooled generation allowance, so seats get cheaper the larger the team gets.

editor_settings.title: What’s the cost of additional users?

content.value: None beyond the period you have paid for. Monthly plans can be cancelled before the next renewal and annual plans are discounted for paying up front; either way your content stays exportable.

item_title.value: What languages does Sassly AI support?

content.value: What languages does Sassly AI support?

Over thirty languages for both drafting and editing, including right-to-left scripts. Brand voice settings carry across all of them, so a guideline written once applies to every language you publish in.
